# hls.js 1.7.3 (light build)

HLS playback for browsers without native HLS (Firefox, most notably). Loaded on demand by
`assets/js/watch/players/aniliberty.js`; browsers that play HLS natively never download it.

- Source: npm package `hls.js@1.7.3`, file `dist/hls.light.min.js`, unmodified.
- Integrity of the npm tarball: `sha512-MsPlx6yVW4Qv4C7mEVou4/gk/5cN2dVxOTnrNjPSmyH2f0Ln+/UkG10Ax1PE6OvrmTVPKgQYozTtBaPOuCzq7A==`
- License: Apache License 2.0, copyright Dailymotion (see `LICENSE`).

To update: download the tarball from the npm registry, compare its sha512 with the registry's
`dist.integrity`, copy `dist/hls.light.min.js` and `LICENSE` here, and update this file.
